blocks.text: INDIANAPOLIS — Dallas forward Cooper Flagg exited early in the Mavericks’ win over the Indiana Pacers with a left shoulder injury on Friday night. Last season’s NBA Rookie of the Year was injured late in the first half when he appeared headed for a breakaway dunk. Pacers swingman Aaron Nesmith fouled Flagg hard from behind, knocking Flagg off balance and he landed awkwardly on the shoulder under the basket.
